_comment: THE music-architecture catalogue (2.90.0; second engine 2.229.0). Same
doctrine as lib/imageArch.json: lib/styles.js, the Settings -> Music tab
(GET /api/musicarchs) and music_worker.py all read this ONE file, so the
dropdown, the defaults and the renderer cannot disagree.
ONE ENTRY PER MUSIC MODEL. 2.229.0 (Tim: 'use dropdown to change from
minimax to yue2(we will probably add more models later'): an entry now
carries `engine` - 'comfy' rides an Export (API) workflow through the
user's ComfyUI as always; 'yue2' rides the pinned YuE2 pipeline in its
own venv (get-yue2.ps1; music_worker.run_yue2). Adding a model = one
entry here + a starter style in lib/styles.js (+ a workflow for comfy
engines, or a worker branch for a genuinely new runtime).
THE LYRICS ARE THE PROMPT; the caption is the STYLE (unchanged for both
engines - YuE2 calls the caption its 'style prompt').

archs.label: MiniMax Music3
archs.caption_hint:
Global Metadata: genre, BPM, key, mood.

Vocal Details: who sings and how.

Arrangement: instruments, intro/verse/chorus/outro.
archs.note: Text + lyrics to a full song with vocals. The caption (genre, BPM, key, mood, vocal, arrangement) is the style; the lyrics are the prompt, with [Verse] / [Chorus] / [Instrumental] section tags. cfg 1.7 and 30 steps are the ComfyUI template defaults.

archs.label: YuE2
archs.caption_hint: Style prompt, one line: language, genre, voice, instruments, mood, BPM. Example: English, warm piano pop, expressive female voice, acoustic piano, rounded bass and light drums, lyrical memorable melody, unhurried phrasing, 88 BPM
archs.notes: Runs the official YuE2 pipeline (pinned yue2-v0.1.6) in its own venv - install with get-yue2.ps1. Needs an NVIDIA GPU with BF16 and ~24 GB VRAM; model files download from Hugging Face on FIRST use. Song length follows the lyrics and the model's plan - the Length field does not apply. Output is 48 kHz stereo FLAC.
archs._defaults_note: steps/cfg/sampler/scheduler are shape-fillers for the shared style normalizer - the yue2 engine ignores them (the pipeline plans its own rendering); max_duration is uncapped-in-practice

archs.label: YuE2 (ComfyUI)
archs.caption_hint: YuE2's style prompt - genre, instruments, voice, mood (e.g. 'violin with girl singing jpop anime')
archs.lyrics_hint: [verse] / [chorus] tags on their own lines - the words of the song
archs.note: ComfyUI-NATIVE YuE2 (2.236.0, Tim's yue2_full.json): the song is written as ABC sheet notation first (YuE2GenerateABC), then sung from that score. Files ComfyUI needs: the checkpoint yue2_convrot_int8.safetensors in models/checkpoints, and for the Cover/Transcribe tabs sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors in models/audio_encoders. The music dock's Sheet Music tab shows the score; every song saves its .abc beside the audio.
